eva: FYI holding the canary for merge 3421 — p95 latency up ~25% on INT8 nightly workload after we enabled the KV prefetcher in kernel selector :hold:
jason: ugh, saw that in alerts. raw numbers?
eva: perfbot posted the bench: p50 42ms -> 45ms, p95 120ms -> 150ms, token/sec down 12%. test suite is int8-seq-long-regen.
perfbot: [bench run id 2026-03-10-22] model=gpt-medium quant=int8 workers=8 batch=auto kv_prefetch=adaptive
perfbot: baseline p95=120.3ms current p95=150.7ms (+25.3%). CPU UTIL on decode thread +18%.
matt: my hunch: prefetcher changes memory access pattern so dequant path trips an extra memcpy / memcpy fallback. saw similar with fp8 prefetch in past.
rachel: can we repro locally with perf tools? I can try a flamegraph on a single instance.
jason: doing a quick bisect on master -> suspect merge 3421 (kernel selector + prefetch) or 3417 (batching heuristics). starting with 3421 revert.
ci-bot: ci/bench-int8 failed: threshold_exceeded on job int8-nightly (p95 increased beyond 10%).
eva: noted. that's why holding rollout. Can we toggle kv_prefetch=off as a hotfix?
matt: yes we have an env flag kernel.KV_PREFETCH=0 that flips the prefetch path at runtime. patch suggestion: add canary override to config map.
jason: quick test: toggled KV_PREFETCH=0 on one canary shard, p95 dropped back to 122ms within 2 minutes.
perfbot: canary toggle results: kv_prefetch=off p95=123.1ms, token/sec back to -1.5% vs baseline.
rachel: attaching quick perf output (truncated):
```
# perf top sample
samples  10.2%  runtime  [.] dequant_int8_copy
samples   8.1%  runtime  [.] kv_lookup_prefetch
samples   6.4%  runtime  [.] kernel_selector_dispatch
```
matt: look at L2 miss increase after prefetcher fires. prefetcher is pulling KV lines for subsequent tokens but causes eviction of hot dequant scratch pages for int8 path.
eva: interesting — so prefetcher helps long-horizon KV reuse but regresses short-horizon int8 decode. workload distribution matters.
jason: plan: 1) revert kernel change in 3421 that forces prefetcher on for all kernels 2) introduce adaptive heuristic based on seq-length histogram and dequant_cost signal 3) patch canary to default off until we ship refine.
matt: I'll prepare a minimal revert PR for 3421 (WIP) and a follow-up PR with adaptive heuristic.
perfbot: rollback PR bench run queued. expecting results in ~20m.
jeva: small note for release notes: call out interplay batching+kv-prefetch+dequant for future release testing.
rachel: also add a CI perf test that runs seq-length skewed cases and asserts p95 delta < 8% for int8 profiles.
ci-bot: perf job queued: bench-rollback-3421. Will post results.
jason: thanks everyone. if rollback PR passes CI let's cut the revert and unhold rollout. otherwise we'll keep canary override. :thumbsup:
eva: adding a short reproducer script to the issue so SRE can run on dedicated infra.
matt: note for follow-up: consider adding a telemetry metric dequant_backpressure and kv_prefetch_evictions to help root cause in-prod.
perfbot: bench-rollback-3421 result: p95=121.9ms (within baseline). rollback PR looks good.
jeva: great — merging revert now, will monitor. thanks all for quick response :rocket:
